proofs.text: Set a project up through init with no spec written and verify the shim exits 0 printing no `purlin:` line; delete `.purlin/` and run `scripts/hooks/pre-push.sh` directly, verifying exit 0 with empty stdout; run the same script in a directory that is not a git repository, with the repository search stopped above it, and verify exit 0 with empty stdout. Run every one of these through the plainest POSIX shell the host has, dash where there is one, since `sh` is bash under another name on some hosts and takes extensions dash rejects; and verify the script's first line asks for `/bin/sh` and its only `set` line is `set -u`

rule_text: The hook exits 0 and prints nothing when there is no project to check: no specs, no `.purlin/`, or no git repository

tests.body:
def test_a_project_that_is_not_a_purlin_project_exits_zero(self, passing):
        shutil.rmtree(passing.path('.purlin'), ignore_errors=True)
        done = subprocess.run([SH, HOOK_SCRIPT], cwd=passing.root,
                              capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=300,
                              stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL)
        assert done.returncode == 0, done.stdout + done.stderr
        assert done.stdout == ''
tests.name: test_a_project_that_is_not_a_purlin_project_exits_zero

def test_a_project_with_no_specs_exits_zero(self):
        made = Project(specs=False)
        try:
            done = made.push()
            assert done.returncode == 0, done.stdout + done.stderr
            assert 'purlin:' not in done.stdout
        finally:
            made.close()
tests.name: test_a_project_with_no_specs_exits_zero

def test_outside_a_repository_it_exits_zero(self):
        directory = tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix='purlin-norepo-')
        env = dict(os.environ)
        env.update(OUTSIDE)
        try:
            done = subprocess.run([SH, HOOK_SCRIPT], cwd=directory, env=env,
                                  capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=300,
                                  stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL)
            assert done.returncode == 0, done.stdout + done.stderr
            assert done.stdout == ''
        finally:
            shutil.rmtree(directory, ignore_errors=True)
tests.name: test_outside_a_repository_it_exits_zero

def test_the_script_asks_for_sh_and_sets_no_option_outside_posix(self):
        """The one line that decides which shell reads the rest of the file.

        A host whose `sh` is dash has no `pipefail`, and `set -o pipefail`
        there exits 2 before line 2 of the script, which is a block.
        """
        lines = read(HOOK_SCRIPT).splitlines()
        assert lines[0] == '#!/bin/sh'
        options = [line for line in lines if line.startswith('set ')]
        assert options == ['set -u'], options
tests.name: test_the_script_asks_for_sh_and_sets_no_option_outside_posix
